summary: The player weaves between incoming pink bullets, fires several shots and charged blasts, and loses two hull points when colliding with enemies or bullets.

events.evidence: A white projectile travels upward from the player ship.
The player ship moves sharply to the right.
A wide white arc projectile is fired upward accompanied by a whooshing sound.
The player ship reverses direction and moves to the left.
The wide white arc travels off the top of the playfield without hitting any enemies.
A wide white arc and a small shot are fired upward.
The screen flashes red, a heavy impact sound plays, and the top-right HULL indicator drops from 4 to 3 bars.
The wide arc hits an enemy near the top center.
A small white projectile is fired upward as the ship moves right.
The tap shot hits the targeted enemy at the top center, which vanishes with a small flash and sound.
A wide white arc is released from the right side of the screen.
The player ship moves from the right side back toward the left.
The wide arc sweeps through the cluster of three enemies on the right.
Following the arc hit, one or more enemies in the right group lose their red glow/parts and drift away.
A single white projectile is fired upward.
The player ship changes direction from left to right.
A wide white arc and a small shot are fired at close range toward incoming enemies.
The screen flashes bright red, an impact sound plays, and the HULL indicator drops from 3 to 2 bars as an enemy/bullet hits the ship.

readability_issues.issue: Enemy ships and enemy bullets are both small, round, and outlined in pink/magenta, making it very difficult to distinguish enemies from projectiles at a glance.
The bright white glow of the player ship and its firing effect obscures the pink bullet/enemy colliding with the player.
